item.title: Lab 12: Building a Custom Kali Linux Pentester Toolbox Container
item.description:
Executive Summary #

This lab demonstrates how to build a custom, lightweight, and portable Kali Linux Pentester Toolbox Container using Docker. Instead of deploying heavy Kali Linux virtual machines or installing security utilities directly on target hosts, penetration testers can quickly launch this container in any environment (Cloud, On-Premises, or Pivot Nodes) for reconnaissance, vulnerability analysis, web app assessment, and network security testing.

item.title: Lab 11: Building a Custom Linux System Administrator Toolbox Container
item.description:
Executive Summary #

This lab demonstrates how to build a custom Docker image designed specifically for Linux System Administrators. The container provides a portable troubleshooting and administration environment that includes commonly used networking, DNS, monitoring, security, and automation tools. Instead of installing utilities on multiple servers, administrators can launch a single container containing all essential tools required for diagnostics, troubleshooting, and infrastructure management.

item.title: Lab 10: Self-Hosted Automated AI Resume Tailoring Pipeline
item.description:
Executive Summary #

This project demonstrates a self-hosted, privacy-focused automation pipeline built using Docker, n8n, Ollama (Llama 3), and CloudConvert. The solution automates the process of tailoring a candidate’s master resume and generating a matching cover letter specific to any target job description.

By running Large Language Models (LLMs) locally via Ollama, sensitive personal data never leaves the host infrastructure during the generation process. The final output is automatically compiled into a clean, employer-ready Microsoft Word document (.docx) and saved to a local workspace.

item.title: Lab 9: Building a Local AI News Automation Agent with Docker, Ollama, n8n & Telegram
item.description:
Executive Summary #

This lab demonstrates how to build an automated, self-hosted AI news digestion pipeline using Docker, Ollama, n8n, and Telegram on Ubuntu 22.04 LTS. The primary objective is to replace manual website searching with an intelligent agent that fetches cybersecurity and IT news from RSS feeds, summarizes the key details locally using an open-source Large Language Model (Llama 3), and automatically delivers structured daily updates to a personal Telegram chat. By hosting all AI processes locally via Ollama, this solution ensures data privacy, reduces operational API costs, and optimizes daily security monitoring workflows.
